---
title: "LD_output_analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(minpack.lm)

# ---- parameters ---------------------------------------------------------
types    <- c("SNPs", "CNVs", "Indels", "SVs")
max_dist <- 20000     # bp; matches --ld-window-kb 20
clump_r2 <- 0.6       # your --clump-r2

# Bin size is a PLOTTING/estimation choice, not a clumping parameter.
# Noise in each bin depends on pairs-per-bin, so widen bins for sparse types:
#   SNPs   ~4.2M pairs  -> 100 bp bins are precise
#   Indels/CNVs/SVs few pairs -> wider bins pool more pairs -> stable mean
bin_by_type      <- c(SNPs = 100, CNVs = 2000, Indels = 1000, SVs = 2000)
MIN_PAIRS_TO_FIT <- 5000   # below this, too sparse to fit a decay curve

# ---- worker: read one .ld, bin, fit -------------------------------------
process_type <- function(ty) {
  f <- sprintf("ld_tables/ld_%s.ld", ty)
  if (!file.exists(f)) { message("MISSING: ", f); return(NULL) }
  bs <- bin_by_type[[ty]]                          # per-type bin width
  ld <- fread(f)                                   # CHR_A BP_A ... BP_B ... R2
  ld[, Distance := abs(BP_B - BP_A)]
  ld <- ld[Distance > 0 & Distance <= max_dist]
  if (!nrow(ld)) { message("no pairs: ", ty); return(NULL) }

  ld[, Bin := floor(Distance / bs) * bs + bs/2]    # bin midpoint
  decay <- ld[, .(MeanR2 = mean(R2),
                  Q25    = quantile(R2, .25),
                  Q75    = quantile(R2, .75),
                  FracGE = mean(R2 >= clump_r2),    # frac of pairs above clump-r2
                  N      = .N), by = Bin][order(Bin)]
  decay[, type := ty]

  # Fit exponential decay only if there are enough pairs to mean anything
  fit <- NULL
  if (nrow(ld) >= MIN_PAIRS_TO_FIT) {
    fit <- tryCatch(
      nlsLM(MeanR2 ~ a*exp(-Bin/b) + c, data = decay,
            start = list(a = 0.5, b = 2000, c = 0.1),
            control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200)),
      error = function(e) { message("fit failed for ", ty, ": ",
                                    conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  } else {
    message(ty, ": only ", nrow(ld), " pairs - too sparse to fit, no clump-kb")
  }

  b_const <- half_decay <- window95 <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    p <- coef(fit); b_const <- p["b"]
    half_decay <- as.numeric(p["b"] * log(2))    # local LD halves
    window95   <- as.numeric(p["b"] * log(20))   # local LD -> 5% (captures ~95%)
  }
  # Data-driven window: largest distance where >=1% of pairs still exceed clump_r2.
  # This is the quantity that actually maps to --clump-kb.
  emp_win <- suppressWarnings(max(decay[FracGE >= 0.01 & N >= 20, Bin]))
  emp_win <- if (is.finite(emp_win)) emp_win else NA_real_

  list(decay = decay, fit = fit, bin = bs,
       summary = data.table(
         type = ty, n_pairs = nrow(ld), bin_bp = bs,
         plateau_c   = if (!is.null(fit)) round(coef(fit)["c"], 3) else NA_real_,
         decay_b_bp  = round(b_const),
         half_decay_bp = round(half_decay),
         window95_bp   = round(window95),          # candidate --clump-kb (fit)
         emp_window_bp = emp_win))                  # candidate --clump-kb (data)
}

res <- lapply(types, process_type)
names(res) <- types
res <- res[!vapply(res, is.null, logical(1))]

# ---- summary table ------------------------------------------------------
summary_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "summary"))
print(summary_tbl)
fwrite(summary_tbl, "LD_decay_summary.csv")

# ---- derive ONE clump-kb from SNPs, apply to all types ------------------
snp <- summary_tbl[type == "SNPs"]
clump_kb_bp <- if (nrow(snp) && !is.na(snp$emp_window_bp)) {
  snp$emp_window_bp
} else if (nrow(snp)) {
  snp$window95_bp
} else {
  NA_real_
}
cat(sprintf("\n>> SNP-derived clump window: %.0f bp (%.1f kb)\n",
            clump_kb_bp, clump_kb_bp/1000))
cat(">> Apply this same --clump-kb to ALL variant types.\n")
cat(">> CNV/Indel/SV curves are density-limited - do NOT set per-type windows.\n")

# ---- per-type plots -----------------------------------------------------
cols <- c(SNPs="#2E86AB", CNVs="#E1A100", Indels="#A23B72", SVs="#3B7A57")
for (ty in names(res)) {
  r <- res[[ty]]; d <- r$decay
  pred <- NULL
  if (!is.null(r$fit)) {
    pred <- data.frame(Bin = seq(0, max_dist, length.out = 400))
    pred$MeanR2 <- predict(r$fit, newdata = pred)
  }
  sparse_note <- if (is.null(r$fit)) " (sparse - descriptive only)" else ""
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Bin, MeanR2)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q25, ymax = Q75), fill = cols[ty], alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(color = cols[ty], linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(color = cols[ty], size = 1.0, alpha = 0.6)
  if (!is.null(pred)) p <- p + geom_line(data = pred, aes(Bin, MeanR2),
                                         linetype = "dashed", color = "black")
  p <- p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = clump_r2, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max_dist, 2000),
                       labels = function(x) paste0(x/1000, "kb")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .1)) +
    labs(title = sprintf("LD decay - %s (95 strains)%s", ty, sparse_note),
         subtitle = sprintf("bin %s bp | %s pairs | half-decay %s bp",
                            r$bin, format(r$summary$n_pairs, big.mark=","),
                            r$summary$half_decay_bp),
         x = "Distance between variants (bp)",
         y = expression(paste("Mean ", r^2))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  ggsave(sprintf("LD_decay_%s.png", ty), p, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  fwrite(d, sprintf("LD_decay_%s_binned.csv", ty))
}

# ---- SNP fraction-of-pairs >= clump_r2 vs distance (justifies clump-kb) --
snp_d <- res$SNPs$decay
p_frac <- ggplot(snp_d, aes(Bin, FracGE)) +
  geom_line(color = cols["SNPs"], linewidth = 1.1) +
  { if (!is.na(clump_kb_bp)) geom_vline(xintercept = clump_kb_bp,
        linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") } +
  { if (!is.na(clump_kb_bp)) annotate("text", x = clump_kb_bp, y = 0.9,
        hjust = -0.05, size = 3.4,
        label = sprintf("clump-kb ~ %.1f kb", clump_kb_bp/1000)) } +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max_dist, 2000),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x/1000, "kb")) +
  labs(title = "SNPs: fraction of pairs with r2 >= 0.6 vs distance",
       subtitle = "The distance where this ~vanishes is the natural --clump-kb",
       x = "Distance between variants (bp)",
       y = expression(paste("Fraction of pairs with ", r^2, " >= 0.6"))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave("LD_SNP_frac_ge_0.6.png", p_frac, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ---- overlay (SNPs = the interpretable curve) ---------------------------
all_decay <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "decay"))
p_overlay <- ggplot(all_decay, aes(Bin, MeanR2, color = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = clump_r2, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, name = "Variant type") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max_dist, 2000),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x/1000, "kb")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .1)) +
  labs(title = "LD decay by variant type (95 strains)",
       subtitle = "Only SNPs are dense enough to interpret; others are density-limited",
       x = "Distance between variants (bp)",
       y = expression(paste("Mean ", r^2))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave("LD_decay_overlay_all_types.png", p_overlay, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("\nWrote: per-type PNG+CSV, LD_SNP_frac_ge_0.6.png, overlay, LD_decay_summary.csv\n")

```
